ICS: Respond by discussing education for parents on BRUE and CPR resources to caregiver

Essential Elements of SDM
Define/explain the problem
Present options
Discuss pros/cons (benefits/risks/costs)
Discuss patient values/preferences
Discuss patient ability/self-efficacy to follow through with plan
Present doctor knowledge/recommendations
Check/clarify understanding
Make or explicitly defer decision
Arrange follow-up

Ideal Elements of SDM
Unbiased information
Define roles (desire for involvement)
Present evidence
Mutual agreement
